suite: G11 Knowledge Vault + G12 Hybrid RAG

results.title: Bootstrap: two tenants, vault roles, fixture documents indexed with real embeddings
notes: fixtures: fts 02664156-a0fa-4910-a82c-04dd72b78e53 (1 chunk), semantic c9b1305c-4e6d-4c8a-bac9-fdc0aa5ca753, large fac136e3-3028-4bc0-aec0-5efc8f06224b (5 chunks), foreign be9e55a6-e47d-47c7-8711-fbe0830409a9

results.title: POST /knowledge/documents contract: 201, docId plus chunk count, row and metadata written
notes: stored 2 windows, all vector(768), tsvector populated, chunk metadata.title = "E2E G11 Trimmed Title 20261021071604"
the ingest DTO carries the full "content" string but knowledge_docs has no content column: only the chunked text is stored

results.title: Ingest guards: title and content must be non-empty text, malformed bodies rejected with 400
notes: these payloads used to raise unhandled 500s: the DTO fields are now unknown-typed and validated in IngestDocumentUseCase
a JSON scalar body is rejected by the parser (express strict mode) and surfaced as a 500 until errorHandler.ts mapped entity.parse.failed to 400
guard attempts left 0 document rows

results.title: Ingest length limits: title 255, category/domain 100, content 1,000,000 characters
notes: an oversize body is rejected before any row is created, so no orphan document or chunk is written

results.title: Ingest label defaults: category and domain default to GENERAL when omitted or null, reject empty strings
notes: omitted or null category/domain become GENERAL, but an empty-string or non-string label is a 400 — the fallback is only triggered by undefined/null

results.title: GET /knowledge/documents list envelope: pagination meta, ordering, serialized columns
notes: total 8, totalPages 1, first page 8 rows, newest "E2E G11 Nulls 20261021071604"

results.title: List filters: category, domain, title search and combinations
notes: filters: category 2, domain 1, search 1, combo 1, unknown 0

results.title: List pagination: page and limit boundaries, invalid values rejected
notes: an empty page value falls back to the default, every other non-integer value is a 400

results.title: Vault isolation: organization B cannot list, read or search organization A documents
notes: cross-tenant access answers 404 rather than 403, so the vault does not confirm that an id exists in another tenant

results.title: GET /knowledge/documents/:id contract: full row shape, no content or embedding leakage
notes: row shape: id,organizationId,uploadedBy,title,category,domain,fileUrl,fileType,totalTokens,totalChunks,createdAt,updatedAt
knowledge_docs content columns: 0 (the raw text only survives inside document_chunks)

results.title: GET /knowledge/documents/:id guards: unknown id 404, malformed UUID 400, anonymous 401
notes: a malformed id is now a 400 from the shared UUID validator; it used to reach PostgreSQL and raise a 500

results.title: DELETE /knowledge/documents/:id: 204, chunks and embeddings cascade away with the document
notes: after delete: knowledge_docs=0 document_chunks=0 (FK ON DELETE CASCADE verified)

results.title: DELETE guards: replay 404, foreign 404 leaves the row, malformed UUID 400, anonymous 401
Role coverage: a VIEWER can ingest and delete knowledge because the vault routes have no role guard
notes: knowledgeRoutes.ts applies requireAuth + requireOrganization only: POST /documents and DELETE /documents/:id are writable by VIEWER, unlike the proposal and portal write routes which are role-checked
the same gap covers POST /rag/ingest, POST /rag/search and POST /knowledge/ask

results.title: POST /knowledge/ask guards: question, domain and topK validated before any provider call
notes: guards run before the embedding and LLM calls, so they answer 400 even while the AI service is offline

results.title: POST /knowledge/ask live path: grounded citations, or a sanitized 502 while the AI service is offline
notes: answer path skipped with the 502: the FastAPI LLM service on http://localhost:8000 is offline, retrieval guards are covered by G11-14

results.title: POST /rag/search hybrid ranking: the rare-token document wins, chunk shape is safe
notes: hits 5, top "E2E G11 Rare Token Doc 20261021071604" score 0.0327868852459016 semanticRank 1 ftsRank 1
every chunk reports chunkIndex 0: hybrid_search_chunks does not select chunk_index, so consumers cannot show which part of a document matched

results.title: Search topK: default 3, boundary 1 and 20 honored, invalid values rejected
notes: widths: default 3, topK=1 1, topK=20 13

results.title: Search guards: query type, blank, oversize and domain validation
notes: a numeric query used to reach the embedding gateway and raise a 500; it is now a 400

results.title: Search domain filter and semantic-only recall across the fixture corpus
notes: HEALTH 1 hits, PAYMENTS 1 hits, unknown domain 0 hits

results.title: Search isolation: organization B cannot retrieve organization A vectors and vice versa
notes: org B rare-token search returned 1 rows (none from org A), own-token search returned 1

results.title: POST /rag/ingest parity with the vault endpoint: same validation, same rows, plus a message
notes: this endpoint used to raise unhandled 500s for a numeric title, numeric content and numeric domain — the shared IngestDocumentUseCase now rejects all three with 400

results.title: Duplicate content: the same text ingested twice yields two documents and no deduplication
notes: there is no content hash or uniqueness constraint: identical text is embedded, stored and re-ranked twice

results.title: Large document: 1500-word sliding windows are all searchable and capped by topK
notes: window openings: "driven billing and…", "the platform route…", "driven billing and…", "segment7 platform …", "segment14 platform…"
5/5 returned windows belong to the 1500-word document
window lengths 705-2823 chars, null vectors 0

results.title: Ingest rollback invariant: no knowledge_docs row survives without its chunks in either tenant
notes: 17 chunks across both tenants, all vector(768) and all tsvector-populated, zero chunk-less documents
the embedding-failure rollback itself could not be forced: the provider is Gemini, so a synthetic 502 cannot be injected against it

results.title: POST /rag/generate-proposal guards: rfpText and maxTokens validated before any provider call
notes: maxTokens arrives through Number(), so "lots" becomes NaN and is rejected as a non-integer rather than reaching the LLM

results.title: POST /rag/generate-proposal live path: overview plus sources, or a sanitized 502 while the AI service is offline
notes: generation skipped with the 502 after 440 ms: retrieval ran first (topK is fixed at 3 inside the use case) and only the LLM call failed

results.title: Teardown: every document removed through the API, zero rows left for both tenants
notes: 11 documents deleted, PostgreSQL confirms 0 knowledge_docs and 0 document_chunks for both tenants
